<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Zoaem (Ring Archon)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2832)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

These endlessly curious archons are formed from spinning wheels of golden light given corporeal shape. They serve as lookouts and mobile support troops for the archon legions, at times uniting to form powerful warriors of light called gestalts. Larger collectives of zoaems can even temporarily fuse into greater archons, approaching the power of the first zoaem, which broke itself apart to serve [Heaven](/Planes.aspx?ID=41) more efficiently.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Celestial](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Zoaem](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2832)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Archon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=536" />
<trait label="Celestial" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=551" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 26

**Perception** +6; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115), [Utopian](/Languages.aspx?ID=36)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +8, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +6, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** -5

**Dex** +3

**Con** +1

**Int** -1

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +6 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +4 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20
([all-around vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=49))

</row>

**Immunities**
[fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598)

**Resistances**
[fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) 3

**Weaknesses**
[unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) 3

**Archon's Protection** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** An enemy damages the archon's ally and both are within 15 feet of the archon; **Effect** The ally gains resistance 3 to all damage against the triggering damage and the archon can make a Strike against the enemy.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** fly 40 feet

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
eye ray +8 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** 1d8 fire

**Divine Innate Spells** DC 17
- **Cantrips (1st)**
[Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171)
- **1st**
[Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)
- **4th**
[Read Omens](/Spells.aspx?ID=247)

**Behold!** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** The zoaem's rings and wings move in a complex pattern, mesmerizing creatures in the zoaem's choice of a 10-foot emanation or a 5-foot burst within 60 feet. Each creature must succeed at a DC 17 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with the zoaem for 1 minute and [stunned 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=93) (or stunned for 1 round on a critical failure).

**Light of Truth** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) The zoaem shines an intense light of truth, as [_revealing light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1653) but in a 60-foot line. Against creatures affected by this light, the zoaem and their allies gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls and [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) checks. The zoaem can't use Light of Truth again for 1d4 rounds.

</column>
